utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Can we lock in the community hall drop-off time first? Once that’s settled, I can sort the repair drive timing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes—let’s lock that in first. What drop-off time works best for the community hall?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Setup, carrying stuff, and basic fixing skills would all help next weekend. If you can lend a hand, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s still on for next weekend, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can help with that—what part of the repair drive do you want me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — could you handle check-in and direct folks to the community center on Sunday? I’m keeping everything organized for the move from the porch to there.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, which repair drive do you mean? I haven’t checked much yet, so I might be missing something.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I mean the neighborhood repair drive we’ve been talking about. Could you help lay out what needs doing and suggest a time for us to meet?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’ll meet you at the community hall first, then we can sort out the repair drive timing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Right — let’s meet at the community hall first, then we can sort out the repair drive timing after that.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still keeping track of the repair drive locations—do you want the drop-off spot or the next place on the list?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can use the drop-off spot, thanks — and if you need any tools brought over, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that. What part of the repair drive do you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — could you help keep track of supplies and see what we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That would be wonderful, Uli—quiet help with sorting donations or a few drop-offs would make a big difference. I’ll keep everything low-key and work around your schedule.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That works for me — I can handle a few quiet drop-offs when I’m able.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes—could you send the time and address, and let me know if you still need the drill?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely—I’ll send the time and address, and I’ll check on the drill right away.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—what kind of help do you need?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—right, I keep losing the spots. Could you remind me of the drop-off spot for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Which repair drive do you mean, and what’s already been checked so far?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I mean the neighborhood repair drive at the community center lot — I’m still planning to come by around 10 with a drill if I have one.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — we’re just ironing out the time, spot, and tools now. I’ll let you know as soon as the details are locked in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Tess — appreciate the update. Let me know when you’ve got the time and spot sorted, and I’ll help with whatever you need.
